verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰ ਅੰਜੁਲਿ ਜਲ ਜੋਬਨ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸੁ ਆਲੀ
verses.translit_en: kar a(n)jul jal joban praves aalee

en.bdb: (A woman who has met Him instructs a worldly woman).

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨ ਤਜਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਰਤਿ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: maan taj praanapat pat rat maaneeaai ||

en.bdb: O! friend entering in youth! abandon all ego and take water (of humility) in your hand, worship the Lord husband the Master of all lives and lodge His love in your heart.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੰਧ੍ਰਬ ਨਗਰ ਗਤਿ ਰਜਨੀ ਬਿਹਾਤ ਜਾਤ ਅਉਸਰ ਅਭੀਚ ਅਤਿ ਦੁਲਭ ਕੈ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: ga(n)dhrab nagar gat rajanee bihaat jaat aausar abheech at dhulabh kai jaaneeaai ||

en.bdb: Like an imaginary world, this night-like life being imaginary is passing by. So consider this human birth as an invaluable opportunity that stars have favoured you with for meeting the Lord God.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਹਜਾ ਕੁਸਮ ਕੁਮਲਾਤ ਮੁਰਝਾਤ  ਪੁਨਿ ਪੁਨਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਤ ਸਮੋ ਆਵਤ ਨ ਆਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: sihajaa kusam kumalaat murajhaat  pun pun pachhutaat samo aavat na aaneeaai ||

en.bdb: As the flowers on the nuptial bed withers away, this invaluable time once gone past will not return. One will repent repeatedly.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਬਰ ਨਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਯ ਪਿਆਰ ਅਧਿਕਾਰੀ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਸਮਝ ਸਿਆਨੀ ਤੋ ਸੋ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਬਖਾਨੀਐ ॥੬੫੯॥
verses.translit_en: soiee bar naar piray piaar adhikaaree piaaree samajh siaanee to so benatee bakhaaneeaai ||659||

en.bdb: O dear friend! I pray to you to be wise and understand this important fact, that she alone is supreme seeker female, who becomes dejure owner of her Lord's love and, ultimately becomes His beloved.  (659)
